title: Clocknext — What did that AI run actually earn?
concept: Follow one example agent run (run_4821 for Acme Inc., one voice call) from usage to billable charge to margin. One blue highlight carries the same run across three real Clocknext screens.
footnotes: REAL UI: clocknext.com metering view, the Voice call composite ($0.45 / call), the Acme Inc. customer margin view (74.9%), lockup and button labels.
EXAMPLE FIGURES (labelled on screen) reconcile: provider cost $0.11 + you keep $0.34 = charge $0.45 (75.6%). $0.45 / call is Clocknext's own example price. Acme Inc. is their example customer.

Brand note: clocknext.com itself is cream and amber with Petrona headlines. This film follows the concept's navy / cool-white / blue direction around their real UI. A cream-and-amber version is a quick switch if they prefer their site look.
